Deal notes of the firm's counsel (Willkie Farr & Gallagher), a layer found
during the control pass of 2026-09-27: the counsel publishes a short note for
most of the firm's transactions and states in words what the firm's own posts
often leave out (control investment, acquisition, majority, minority, the
round's name). Input: the counsel's sitemap. A note is pulled when its URL
names the firm, or names a company of the base (slug match, 5+ characters).
Output: sources/web/willkie-notes.json, one row per note with the base slugs
it matches, its title, date, first paragraphs and the control words found.
Usage: python3 .../scratch/willkie-notes.py <sitemap.xml>

https://www.willkie.com/news/2026/01/wil.title: Willkie Advises Platinum Equity on Acquisition of Czarnowski Collective
https://www.willkie.com/news/2026/01/wil.text: Willkie represented Platinum Equity in its acquisition of experiential marketing services firm Czarnowski Collective from Mark Nagle and the Nagle family. Founded in 1947 and headquartered in Chicago, Czarnowski is a collection of integrated agencies providing end-to-end solutions for trade shows, corporate events, meetings, conferences, and other live experiences. Its services include brand strategy and creative development, exhibit fabrication, onsite installation and support, asset rental, storage and logistics. Founded in 1995 by Tom Gores, Platinum Equity is a global investment firm with approximately $50 billion of assets under management and a portfolio of approximately 60 operating companies. The Willkie team was led by partners Ray LaSoya and Joe Kaczorowski and included counsel Noah Goodman and associates Charles (Chip) Winkler, Amirali Agha-Khan, Brandon Park-Lee and Sophia Bordofsky.

Willkie Arbitration Award for Womply Resolves More Than Half a Billion Dollars of Liability
https://www.willkie.com/news/2024/06/wil.text: Willkie litigators recently secured a major arbitration victory for Womply, a Paycheck Protection Program (PPP) technology service provider, securing more than $117 million in damages and defeating counterclaims brought by Benworth Capital Partners for more than $420 million. A final award was issued on June 12, resolving more than half a billion dollars in dispute. The high-stakes dispute raised novel regulatory issues related to the PPP, a government program created in response to the COVID-19 pandemic that guaranteed small business loans from private lenders, and the legality of related contract and fee agreements. In 2020, Womply, a technology services provider to small businesses, saw clients struggled to obtain PPP loans because traditional lenders focused on lending to large businesses, which netted lenders larger processing fees. In early 2021, Womply devoted resources to developing a technology platform called “PPP Fast Lane” to lower the barriers to small businesses obtaining PPP loans by making processing, reviewing, and managing a large volume of small-dollar PPP loan applications more efficient for lenders. Benworth, a Florida-based lender, used PPP Fast Lane to fund more than 300,000 PPP loans with a principal amount exceeding $4 billion, for which it received more than $680 million in fees from the SBA; but Benworth failed to pay Womply all of the fees Womply earned under the parties’ agreements. https://www.willkie.com/news/2020/08/the.title: The Sterling Group Forms Frontline Road Safety and Completes the Acquisition of Stripe-A-Zone
https://www.willkie.com/news/2020/08/the.text: On August 3, Willkie client The Sterling Group announced the establishment of Frontline Road Safety ("Frontline"), a new platform formed to build a national leader in the US road safety industry, and the completion of the acquisition of Stripe-A-Zone as the first member of the Frontline family of companies. https://www.willkie.com/news/2020/10/e2o.title: E2open to Become Publicly Traded Company in $2.57 Billion Deal with SPAC CC Neuberger Principal Holdings I
https://www.willkie.com/news/2020/10/e2o.text: On October 14, E2open, a network-based provider of 100% cloud-based, end-to-end supply chain management software, announced it has entered into a business combination agreement with CC Neuberger Principal Holdings I (NYSE: PCPL ), a publicly traded special purpose acquisition company (SPAC). The transaction values E2open at an enterprise value of $2.57 billion. Upon closing of the transaction, E2open will become a publicly traded company, and it is expected that its common stock will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "ETWO". Michael Farlekas, who has served as CEO of E2open since 2015, will continue to lead the business post-transaction. The transaction includes a total equity investment raise of $1.1 billion, and includes $520 million fully committed common stock PIPE at $10 per share. E2open provides a cloud-based software platform to orchestrate complex global supply chains. Its software combines networks, data and applications to provide a deeply embedded, platform for customers to optimize their supply chain from channel shaping and business planning to logistics and global trade to manufacturing and supply management. E2open’s supply chain platform enables companies to use data from clients, distribution channels, suppliers, contract manufacturers and logistics partners in real time, with artificial intelligence and machine learning to drive smarter decisions.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2020/10/vee.text: On October 6, Veeam Software, a leader in backup solutions and data management, announced it has acquired Kasten, a market leader for Kubernetes backup and disaster recovery, in a cash and stock transaction valued at $150 million. https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/byn.title: Bynder Announces Strategic Acquisition of Webdam for $49.1 Million
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/byn.text: The acquisition comes 1.5 years after Bynder’s $22 million Series A funding with Insight Venture Partners. Bynder, a global leader in digital asset management acquired Shutterstock's digital asset management business, known as Webdam (NYSE:SSTK) for $49.1 million. The acquisition brings together digital asset management leaders from EMEA and North America to create a global organization offering marketing and creative teams with cloud-based solutions for managing, distributing and collaborating on their digital assets. The acquisition of Webdam bolsters Bynder’s U.S. presence, including the addition of an office in the San Francisco Bay Area. It also highlights Bynder’s commitment to bring best-in-class DAM (digital asset management) to brand-driven businesses of all sizes, globally. Blending the industry knowledge, technological innovation, and geographic strengths of the two companies—including heavy investments in artificial intelligence and integrations—will allow Bynder to better address evolving customer needs. Bynder is an award-winning digital asset management (DAM) platform offering marketers tools to find and share creative files such as graphics, videos and documents. Webdam, a leader in digital asset management, uses a cloud-based platform to power the visual content that drives impactful brand experiences, and allows brand-building activities to scale across the enterprise and consumer touchpoints.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Invests in CentralReach
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/ins.text: The Insight investment will expand CentralReach’s electronic health record and practice management software offerings for applied behavioral analysis clinics. Willkie represented longtime client Insight Venture Partners on its recent significant investment in CentralReach, a premier provider of electronic health record and practice management software for clinics focused on applied behavioral analysis (ABA) and speech therapy. The Insight investment will allow CentralReach to continue to expand its product capabilities and to accelerate growth. CentralReach’s product portfolio has expanded to cover speech therapy, PK-12 education, and occupational therapy, and includes software capabilities that manage the clinical data collection process, learning management for clinicians, as well as clinic operations such as billing, human resources, analytics, and scheduling. Headquartered in Pompano Beach, Florida, CentralReach delivers powerful software to help ABA clinics treat patients with autism, serving over 500 customers and employing over 100 team members. The self-funded company has grown significantly since inception and increased sales by over 65% in 2017.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/pro.title: Property Brands Announces Investment from Insight Venture Partners to Accelerate Growth
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/02/pro.text: Willkie represents Insight Venture Partners in the transaction. Willkie represented longtime client Insight Venture Partners in its recent investment in Property Brands, a leading provider of property management technology solutions. As a result of the transaction, Insight will retain majority investment control, while Property Brands' previous lead investor, Providence Strategic Growth, will retain a minority investment partnership going forward. The investment and partnership will expand Property Brands' service offerings for property management companies, helping them to solve challenges, become more efficient, reduce operating cost, and improve resident experience. Headquartered in Knoxville, Tennessee, Property Brands provides software for property management, rent payment processing, background screening, and renters insurance. Property Brands is helmed by an executive team of proven entrepreneurs who have successfully built market leading SaaS companies.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/05/vir.title: Virgin Pulse Acquired by Marlin Equity Partners
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/05/vir.text: Willkie client Virgin Pulse will merge with Marlin-owned RedBrick Health to create world’s largest digital employee wellbeing and engagement company. Providence-based Virgin Pulse and Minneapolis-based RedBrick Health announced that the industry pioneers will merge, creating the world’s largest, most comprehensive digital health and engagement company. The merger will establish the industry’s only fully integrated digital platform, with benefits navigation and live coaching to support global clients and members across the entire health, wellbeing and benefits lifecycle. Marlin Equity Partners is acquiring Virgin Pulse from its prior investors, which includes Willkie client Insight Venture Partners. RedBrick and Virgin Pulse will unite under the Virgin Pulse name but continue to operate as separate brands. Together, Virgin Pulse and RedBrick have the largest customer base in the industry, with over 3,300 clients including public sector organizations, health plans, universities and more than 20 percent of the Fortune Global 500 companies across 190 countries. Virgin Pulse, a part of Sir Richard Branson’s Virgin Group, is a technology solutions provider that promotes employee engagement and wellbeing. RedBrick combines advanced behavior science, adaptive technology and a deep bench of live experts to help companies transform the health of their organizations.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/06/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Leads $200 Million Growth Equity Investment in Jama Software
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/06/ins.text: The investment will further the expansion of Jama’s predictive product development software. Oregon software company Jama Software announced a $200 million growth equity investment led by Willkie client Insight Venture Partners with participation from Madrona Venture Group. The investment will propel Jama's long-term global growth and drive the expansion of its predictive product development software, helping companies mitigate risk, improve quality, identify opportunities and decrease time to market. Jama Software is a leading product development platform provider for companies building complex products and integrated systems. The Jama Product Development Platform is a comprehensive tool for managing the strategic and operational aspects of product development for complex industries. The platform brings value to the entire development process — from requirements management to providing a combined workflow, content management and analytics solution that overlays all other tools and processes to govern and predict current and future product development. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global private equity and venture capital firm that has raised more than $18 billion and invested in more than 300 growth-stage software, internet, and data services companies.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/06/tri.title: TriTech Software Systems to be Recapitalized by Bain Capital Private Equity
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/06/tri.text: TriTech Software Systems, a leader in public safety technology, announced its recapitalization by Bain Capital Private Equity, a leading global private investment firm. TriTech provides software to over 4,000 police, fire and EMS agencies across the U.S. and was one of the first to embed mapping technology into computer-aided dispatch software. Founded in 1992, TriTech’s software covers every facet within the public safety incident-response workflow, including 9-1-1, computer-aided dispatch, field-based reporting, records management, jail management, analytics and intelligence, patient care reporting, and ambulance billing software. Willkie client Insight Venture Partners was TriTech’s primary investor since 2014. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global private equity and venture capital firm that has raised more than $18 billion and invested in more than 300 growth-stage software, internet, and data services companies. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Gordon Caplan, Rosalind Fahey Kruse and Matthew Haddad and included associate Erin Kinney.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/07/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Closes $6.3 Billion Fund X
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/07/ins.text: Willkie represented Insight Venture Partners in the closing of its largest fund to date, which will be used to further its leading growth equity technology investment engine. On July 19, Willkie client Insight Venture Partners, a leading global private equity and venture capital firm, announced the close of its Fund X at $6.3 billion, the firm's largest to date. The oversubscribed fund will be used to further its leading growth equity technology investment engine. With the close of the new fund, Insight has a total of over $23 billion under management. Since inception in 1995, Insight has seen its software-focused investment strategy drive increasing impact in the technology sector. The firm currently has more than 150 portfolio companies, has overseen more than 225 M&A transactions and has participated in more than 40 IPOs. In the first six months of 2018, three of the top 10 highest valued US venture-backed companies that went public were Insight portfolio companies. Insight has cumulatively invested in more than 300 companies worldwide. Insight’s Fund X follows the firm's previous Fund IX and related growth buyout fund, which closed in 2015 at approximately $5 billion. Willkie advised Insight on the closing of Fund IX as well.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/08/dil.title: Diligent Corporation Acquires Secure Communication Software Provider Brainloop
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/08/dil.text: Diligent Corporation, a leader in enterprise governance management, announced its acquisition of Brainloop, a supplier of virtual data room software used within the enterprise for high-security collaboration on confidential documents. As part of U.S.-based Diligent, Brainloop will continue to operate as an independent company and serve its clients under the Brainloop brand, while having the opportunity to leverage Diligent’s robust global network. Headquartered in Munich, Brainloop will become Diligent’s continental European hub and will continue to be led by its current management team. Together, Diligent and Brainloop will offer a highly complementary product suite to a global base of clients, including Diligent’s industry-leading Governance Cloud offering and Brainloop’s high-security virtual data rooms. Diligent provides secure corporate governance and collaboration solutions to boards and senior executives through its Governance Cloud offering. Over 14,000 clients in more than 90 countries and on all seven continents rely on Diligent for secure distribution of board materials, as well as secure messaging, integrated compliance, board evaluation and entity management. Brainloop provides secure cloud storage for enterprises in Germany and throughout continental Europe, serving thousands of users on six continents, including a number of blue-chip European corporations. The Willkie deal team included partners Gordon Caplan, Dr. Stefan Jörgens, Morgan Elwyn and David Tarr; na

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/09/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Acquires Episerver for $1.16 Billion
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/09/ins.text: Willkie represented longtime client Insight Venture Partners in its acquisition of Episerver, a leading marketing technology and digital commerce company. On September 6, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners has agreed to acquire marketing technology and digital commerce company Episerver for $1.16 billion. The investment will provide Episerver with accelerated product development, go-to-market sales and marketing, and branding initiatives. Episerver expects this transaction to propel its global growth strategy and market presence, and dramatically expand adoption for its Digital Experience Cloud™ platform. Founded in 1994, Episerver has offices in the U.S., U.K., Sweden, Australia, Germany, Denmark, Finland, Norway, the Netherlands, Spain, South Africa, Singapore, Vietnam and the UAE. The Episerver Digital Experience Cloud™ unifies digital content, commerce and marketing in one platform, including omnichannel solutions for smart personalization and intelligent campaigns. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth technology and software companies. Insight currently has over $20 billion of assets under management and has cumulatively invested in more than 300 companies. Willkie most recently represented Insight in closing its $6.3 billion Fund X (its largest fund to date), its growth investment in EveryAction, and in the multi-partner merger of Illuminate Education with SchoolCity, IO

https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/11/e2o.title: E2open Acquires Ocean Shipping Network and Software Provider INTTRA
https://www.willkie.com/news/2018/11/e2o.text: Willkie advised cloud-based supply-chain provider E2open, a portfolio company of Insight Venture Partners, on the transaction. On November 26, E2open, a portfolio company of Insight Venture Partners, completed its acquisition of INTTRA, a leading ocean shipping network, software and information provider. E2open is the largest cloud-based provider of networked supply chain solutions, featuring a complete portfolio of applications that enable the world’s most complex supply chains to better plan, collaborate, and execute their end-to-end operations. The combination of INTTRA’s ocean carrier and shipper network with E2open’s industry leading business network will create a unified global logistics and supply chain network. The Willkie deal team for the current transaction was led by partners Gordon Caplan, Morgan Elwyn and Robert Rizzo and included partner David Tarr and associate Frances Dales.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/01/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Invests in Tricentis
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/01/ins.text: Willkie advises Insight in its $165 million investment in software testing company Tricentis. On January 23, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners has provided $165 million in Series B financing to Tricentis, the Continuous Testing Company for agile enterprise organizations. Tricentis helps more than 400 companies – including HBO, Whole Foods, Toyota, Allianz, BMW, Starbucks, Deutsche Bank, Lexmark, Orange and UBS – achieve software testing automation rates of more than 90 percent. Its integrated software testing solution, Tricentis Tosca, has been proven to achieve 10 times the test-automation efficiency of tools that employ manual scripting. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth software, mobile and internet companies that are driving transformative change in their industries. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Gordon Caplan and Matthew Guercio and included partners Christopher Peters and Michael Katz; counsel Amir Ghavi; associates Matthew Haddad, Adam Remo, Daniel Alster, Christina Mann, Andrea de Vos, Kapiljeet Dargan and Isabel Araujo

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/03/aqu.title: Aquiline Agrees to Sell UK-Based Simply Business to Travelers
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/03/aqu.text: Travelers agreed to approximately $490 million purchase of leading UK business insurance distributor. On March 13, The Travelers Companies, Inc. announced that it has agreed to purchase Simply Business from Willkie client and private equity group, Aquiline Capital Partners LLC, for an enterprise value of approximately $490 million. Operating since 2005, Simply Business is a leading distributor of small and medium sized business insurance policies in the United Kingdom, offering products online on behalf of a broad panel of carriers. It operates a customer-facing aggregator website and other digital distribution technologies to provide innovative insurance solutions to businesses in the U.K. The company has more than 425,000 microbusiness customers, covering more than 1,000 classes of business. Over the past three years, insurance premiums placed by Simply Business grew at a compound annual rate of approximately 17.5 percent to £93 million (approx. $113 million) in 2016. Aquiline acquired Simply Business in 2016 and this agreed sale to Travelers is expected to close in the third quarter of 2017 following regulatory and other approvals. Willkie’s London office acted as legal counsel to Aquiline in both their purchase of Simply Business in 2016 and this sale transaction in 2017.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/04/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Acquires Zyme
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/04/ins.text: Willkie represents Insight in its agreement to acquire a majority stake in leading channel data management company Zyme in a transaction valued at over $100 million. On April 12, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Zyme, the market leader in the rapidly growing discipline of channel data management (CDM), in a transaction valued at over $100 million. The transaction is expected to enable Zyme to build a new solution category around its CDM technology that enables customers across the world to leverage data and analytics to optimize channel marketing, channel sales, channel inventory and partner performance. Based in Redwood Shores, CA, Zyme provides the leading channel data management cloud platform, delivering critical downstream visibility for global companies that leverage distributors, resellers, retailers and e-tailers to sell their products. With a channel directory of more than 1.5 million partners, Zyme processes more than one billion transactions annually across more than 150 countries. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth software and internet-enabled companies that are driving transformative change in their industries.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Acquires Resolve Systems
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/ins.text: Willkie represents Insight in its acquisition of leading enterprise security and IT incident response platform. On May 24, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners acquired Resolve Systems®, the only enterprise-wide incident response and automation platform for security, IT and network operations. The deal is expected to enable Resolve Systems to further extend its leading position in the Incident Response & Resolution market by accelerating its product capabilities, and expanding its global sales, support and delivery infrastructure. Based in Irvine, CA with Operations in EMEA, Resolve Systems has Fortune 500 customers around the world. Resolve accelerates incident response and resolution by providing engineers with human-guided automations, real-time incident collaboration, and the ability to partially and fully automate processes. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth software and internet-enabled companies that are driving transformative change in their industries.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/med.title: Mediware to Acquire Kinnser Software
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/med.text: Willkie represents Kinnser Software, Inc., the leading provider of software solutions for home health and hospice providers, and Insight Venture Partners in the transaction. On May 30, it was announced that Mediware Information Systems, Inc. has finalized an agreement to acquire Kinnser Software, Inc., the leading provider of software solutions for home health and hospice providers, from Insight Venture Partners. Willkie represented Kinnser and Insight in the transaction. The deal enables Mediware to expand its portfolio in the home health and hospice space, creating an integrated, high-growth software provider for the alternate care market. Based in Austin, TX, Kinnser Software serves more than 4,000 home health, hospice, therapy, and private duty home care providers nationwide. Mediware, backed by TPG Capital, has provided software solutions to healthcare providers and has since expanded to serve many state and federal agencies. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth software and internet-enabled companies that are driving transformative change in their industries. In recent months Willkie has represented Insight in its acquisitions of Resolve Systems and Zyme and its investment in Tricentis, as well as in the completion of its $1.4 billion acquisition of Ministry Brands, among other transactions.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/par.title: Parallels Sells Plesk to Oakley Capital
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/par.text: Willkie represents Parallels Holdings Limited, a global leader in IT solutions, in the carve-out and sale of its Switzerland-based web server and website administration platform, Plesk, to Oakley Capital for $105 million. On April 28, Willkie client Parallels Holdings Limited, a global leader in IT solutions announced that it had carved out and sold its Switzerland-based web server and website administration platform, Plesk, to Oakley Capital at an enterprise value of $105 million. Plesk is a leading cloud WebOps platform which allows users to run and grow applications, websites and hosting businesses. Over 50 percent of the world’s top 100 hosting service providers partner with Plesk, and its software runs on over 300,000 servers and operates on over 10 million websites and over 15 million mailboxes. Parallels Holdings Limited will continue to own its ‘Parallels’ cross-platform solutions business unit and its ‘Virtuozzo’ business unit, which develops market leading container virtualization technology. The transaction and the reinvestment by the founders alongside Oakley Capital was handled by partners Gordon Caplan and Matthew Dean and associates Howard Block, David Wall, Gerry Kelly and Joshua Begner, with tax advice from UK partner Judith Harger and associate Shinasa Wasimi. UK partner Sebastian FitzGerald and associate Aymen Mahmoud provided finance advice and associate Matthew Makover provided IP/IT advice.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/sma.title: SmartBear Announces Acquisition by Francisco Partners
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/05/sma.text: Francisco Partners acquires a majority stake in Willkie client SmartBear Software, the leader in software quality tools for teams. On May 3, Willkie client SmartBear Software, the leader in software quality tools for teams, announced that private equity firm Francisco Partners has acquired a majority stake in the company. The acquisition by Francisco Partners marks a transition in lead investors from SmartBear’s original 2007 investor, Insight Venture Partners. During Insight’s period of investment, the company grew from a single product company for U/I testing into an industry leader in software quality tools for teams with multiple product lines and over 20,000 customers. SmartBear has been growing at double digit rates for more than five years. Supporting more than five million software professionals and in 194 countries, Smartbear provides leading products for API testing, UI testing, code review and performance monitoring across mobile, web and desktop applications. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth software, SaaS, mobile and internet-enabled companies that are driving transformative change in their industries. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Gordon Caplan and Morgan Elwyn, and included partners Michael Katz, Eugene Chang, Christopher Peters and David Mortlock, and associates Matthew Haddad, Stephanie Moran, Tai Fukumoto, Matthew Makover, Noman Goheer and Rose Ohanesian.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/07/a-p.title: A Place for Mom Agrees to be Acquired by General Atlantic and Silver Lake
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/07/a-p.text: Willkie represents A Place for Mom, the tech-enabled platform serving families and senior living communities, in its agreement to be acquired by private equity firms Silver Lake and General Atlantic from private equity firm Warburg Pincus LLC. On July 5, Willkie client A Place for Mom, North America's largest network connecting families to senior living service providers, announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by private equity firms Silver Lake and General Atlantic. The company is being sold by its previous investor Warburg Pincus LLC, a leading global private equity firm focused on growth investing. Based in Seattle, A Place for Mom offers a multi-channel marketing and technology platform that connects families to a network of over 18,500 senior living providers in the U.S. and Canada, providing free, personalized assistance. This may include independent senior housing, home care, residential care homes, assisted living communities, memory care and Alzheimer's care. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Jeffrey Poss and Manuel Miranda, and included partners Eugene Chang, Jeffrey Goldfarb, Mark Holdsworth, Christopher Peters and Carly Saviano; counsel Jonathan Konoff; associates Marc Balmazi, Christine Centola, Kathryn Crowe, Christopher Edwab, Caitlin Link, Kurt Lyn, Matthew Makover and Sarah Wong; law clerk Peter Coulson and summer law clerk Gabrielle Young.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/07/del.title: Delivery Hero Prices $1.1 Billion IPO
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/07/del.text: Willkie represents Insight Venture Partners, one of the key investors in Delivery Hero AG, a Berlin-based global online food ordering and delivery marketplace, in connection with the transaction. As reported widely in the international press, global online food ordering and delivery company Delivery Hero AG priced its highly awaited €996 million ($1.1 billion) initial public offering at the top end of its range. The Berlin-based company set a final offer price of €25.50 per share. Willkie represented Insight Venture Partners, one of Delivery Hero’s key investors, in the transaction. A total of 18,950,000 newly issued ordinary registered shares, 15,000,000 existing ordinary registered shares from the holdings of certain existing shareholders, and 5,092,500 ordinary registered shares from the holdings of Global Online Takeaway Group S.A. in connection with an over-allotment were allocated as part of the offering. Citigroup, Goldman Sachs International and Morgan Stanley are acting as Joint Global Coordinators and Joint Bookrunners. UniCredit Bank AG, Berenberg, Jefferies and UBS Investment Bank have been mandated as additional Joint Bookrunners.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/08/fro.title: Frontline Education to be Acquired by Thoma Bravo
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/08/fro.text: Willkie represents Frontline Education in its agreement to be acquired by private equity firm Thoma Bravo, with Insight Venture Partners retaining a minority stake in the company. On August 4, Willkie client Frontline Education, an integrated insights partner serving more than 12,000 educational organizations across America, announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by private equity firm Thoma Bravo. Insight Venture Partners, a prior investor in Frontline Education, will retain a minority stake in the company. Frontline Education, with its awarding-winning administrative and HR software solutions, serves more than 12,000 educational organizations across America and enables them to make evidenced-based decisions that drive better outcomes for both educators and students. Across North America, major educational organizations rely on Frontline Education’s trusted solutions, with more than 5 million education employees and 1.2 million substitutes logging into its systems on a daily basis. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Gordon Caplan and Matthew Guercio, and included partners Hillel Jacobson and Michael Katz, counsel Spencer Simon, associates Christopher Edwab, Stephanie Moran, Guy Inbar, Isabel Araujo, Brandon Coyle, and law clerk Tai Fukumoto.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/10/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Invests in Bullhorn
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/10/ins.text: Willkie represents Insight in its investment in the cloud computing company. On October 23, Bullhorn, the cloud computing company that helps staffing and recruiting organizations transform their businesses, announced a partnership with Willkie client Insight Venture Partners to provide the capital for Bullhorn’s next phase of growth. As part of the transaction, Insight will be purchasing all shares owned by Vista Equity Partners. The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2017. Bullhorn is the global leader in CRM and operations software for the recruitment industry. More than 7,000 staffing companies rely on Bullhorn’s cloud-based platform to drive sales, build relationships, and power their recruitment processes from end to end. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth technology and software companies that are driving transformative change in their industries.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/11/e2o.title: E2open to Acquire Zyme
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/11/e2o.text: Willkie represents E2open and Zyme in the combination, which creates the world’s largest operating network for manufacturing supply chain and sales operations. On November 6, E2open, the largest and most comprehensive supply chain operating network, announced that it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Zyme, the leader in channel data management (CDM). Willkie represented E2open and Zyme, both portfolio companies of Insight Venture Partners, in the transaction. The combination creates the world’s largest operating network for manufacturing, supply chain and sales operations. E2open is powered by the world’s largest direct business network and a broad portfolio of next generation solutions. Zyme provides the leading CDM cloud platform, delivering critical downstream visibility for global companies that leverage distributors, retailers, e-tailers and resellers to sell their products. The combination is expected to provide global manufacturers with unprecedented visibility and control of their manufacturing and sales operations. Willkie represented Insight Venture Partners in its 2015 acquisition of E2open and in its April 2017 acquisition of Zyme. The firm also represented E2open in its 2017 acquisition of Steelwedge and 2016 acquisition of Orchestro.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/11/ins.title: Insight Venture Partner Recapitalizes GraphPad
https://www.willkie.com/news/2017/11/ins.text: Willkie represents Insight in its majority recapitalization of GraphPad Software, Inc., the premier provider of data analysis, statistics and graphing software solutions for scientific research applications. Willkie recently represented Insight Venture Partners on its majority recapitalization of GraphPad Software, Inc., the premier provider of data analysis, statistics and graphing software solutions for scientific research applications. Headquartered in La Jolla, Calif., GraphPad offers powerful statistical analysis, curve-fitting and graphing software solutions designed for scientists with varying levels of statistical knowledge. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global private equity and venture capital firm that has raised more than $18 billion and invested in more than 300 growth-stage software, internet, and data services companies. The Willkie deal team was led by partners Gordon Caplan and Matthew Guercio, and included partners Hillel Jacobson, Michael Katz, Christopher Peters and David Tarr; counsel Spencer Simon; and associates Jonathan Kubek, David Axelson, David Blassberger, Andrea de Vos, Carolyn Dreyspool, Robert Larimore and Rose Ohanesian.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/02/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Acquires Diligent
https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/02/ins.text: Insight acquired the New Zealand software company in a cross-border, take-private transaction valued at approximately US$624 million. On April 14, Willkie client Insight Venture Partners completed its acquisition of New Zealand software company Diligent Corporation for US$4.90 per share in cash, or approximately US$624 million. Insight’s acquisition of Diligent, which debuted on the New Zealand Stock Exchange in 2007, reflects an increase of take-private deals in the wake of market volatility worldwide. Diligent is the leading provider of secure corporate governance and collaboration solutions for boards and senior executives. More than 4,000 clients in more than 60 countries and on all seven continents rely on Diligent to provide secure, intuitive access to their most time-sensitive and confidential information. Insight Venture Partners is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth technology and software companies that are driving transformative change in their industries.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/03/jag.title: Jagex Agrees to Acquisition by Shanghai Hongtou Network
https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/03/jag.text: On March 14, the shareholders of Willkie client Jagex Limited, a leading independent developer and publisher of online games, agreed to sell their entire shareholding in the company to Chinese buyer Shanghai Hongtou Network Technology Co., Ltd. for an undisclosed sum. The deal, which is conditional upon government approval in the PRC, is due to close at the end of June. Jagex is the UK's largest independent games developer and publisher. The company's flagship game, RuneScape, holds numerous Guinness World Records, including that of the world's most popular free-to-play massively multiplayer online game (MMOG). The deal was handled by corporate partners Gordon Caplan and Matthew Dean and associates Phil Coletto and Gerry Kelly, with tax advice from UK partner Judith Harger and associate Shinasa Wasimi.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/aqu.title: Aquiline Capital Partners to Acquire Simply Business
https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/aqu.text: Simply Business is the U.K.’s biggest on-line SMB business insurance provider. On April 11, Willkie client Aquiline Capital Partners LLC announced that it has agreed to acquire Simply Business, the U.K.’s biggest business insurance provider for small and medium-sized businesses. Financial terms were not disclosed. Launched in 2005, Simply Business provides an online brokerage service delivering policies tailored to individual business requirements. It provides insurance to more than 350,000 U.K. small and medium-sized enterprises. Aquiline is a private equity firm based in New York investing in middle-market businesses across the financial services sector in banking and credit, insurance, investment management and markets, and financial technology and services.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/con.title: Conga Completes Multiple Acquisitions
https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/con.text: Conga adds to growing portfolio with its acquisitions of Novatus, ActionGrid and CRMCulture. On April 20, Willkie client Conga, the leading provider of document and report generation solutions for Salesforce customers, announced its acquisitions of: Conga is the developer of the Conga Suite, the #1 document generation and reporting applications for Salesforce. The acquisitions add to Congo’s growing portfolio of enterprise-grade sales acceleration solutions. In June 2015, Willkie represented Insight Venture Partners in its $70 million investment in Conga. Insight is a leading global venture capital and private equity firm investing in high-growth technology and software companies that are driving transformative change in their industries.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/ins.title: Insight Venture Partners Invests in HomeToGo
https://www.willkie.com/news/2016/04/ins.text: Insight leads the investment round in the world’s largest search engine for vacation rentals. https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/05/wil.text: Like its seven predecessor funds, Insight Venture Partners Fund VIII will be invested in the technology sector. On May 29 Willkie client Insight Venture Partners announced the closing of Insight Venture Partners VIII, a $2.57 billion private equity fund. Like its seven predecessor funds, Insight will invest Fund VIII in the technology sector, including global software, e-Commerce, internet and data-services businesses. Investments will be made in growth stage and more mature companies as minority or control transactions. The new fund, which is Insight’s largest, will further Insight’s existing strategy of assisting portfolio companies to achieve their long-term operational and financial goals. It will have the flexibility to invest in opportunities worldwide any amount up to approximately $300 million of equity per transaction. Since its founding in 1995, New York-based Insight has raised more than $7.6 billion and made more than 190 investments worldwide. Willkie has represented Insight in a host of transactions including most recently the $6.9 billion consortium acquisition of BMC Software. The current deal was handled by partners Adrienne Atkinson, Gordon Caplan, Hillel Jacobson, James Brown and Ian Levin, and associates Tracy Thomas, Tina Chan, Brent Morowitz, Kevin Michel, Erin Kinney and Meredith Levy.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/06/fir.title: Firm Advises Insight Venture Partners in Significant Investment in Kaseya
https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/06/fir.text: Insight invests in leading Switzerland-based global provider of IT Service Management software. On June 24, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners has made a significant investment in Kaseya, a leading global provider of IT Service Management software based in Lausanne, Switzerland. With over 30 offices in 23 countries, Kaseya provides solutions that are in use by more than 10,000 customers worldwide in a wide variety of industries, including healthcare, education, finance and government, among others. Since its founding in 1995, New York-based Insight has raised more than $7.6 billion and made more than 190 investments worldwide. Willkie has represented Insight in a host of transactions including most recently the $6.9 billion consortium acquisition of BMC Software and in the closing of Insight Venture Partners VIII, a new $2.57 billion private equity fund. The current deal was handled by a multidisciplinary Willkie team including: Corporate - partners Gordon Caplan, Morgan Elwyn and Matthew Guercio, and associates Jacob Kleinman, Saroj Tharisayi, Victoria Rosales and Greg LeSaint; Tax – partner Hillel Jacobson and associate DJ Stauber; Benefits – partner Michael Katz and associate Rose Ohanesian; Intellectual Property – partner Eugene Chang and associate Amir Ghavi and Real Estate – associates Owen Reidy, Edward Dix, Kathryn Allen and Jennifer DiNicola.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/11/fir.title: Firm Advises Insight Venture Partners in Latest Growth Equity Investment
https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/11/fir.text: Insight provides major investment in Unitrends, the leading provider of all-in-one backup, archiving, instant recovery and disaster recovery solutions. On October 31, it was announced that Unitrends, the leading provider of all-in-one backup, archiving, instant recovery and disaster recovery solutions, received a major growth equity investment from Willkie client Insight Venture Partners. The investment will allow Columbia, SC-based Unitrends to continue building upon its recent record growth. Since its founding in 1995, New York-based Insight has raised more than $7.6 billion and invested in more than 190 growth-stage software, eCommerce, internet, and data-services companies. Willkie has represented Insight in a host of transactions including most recently the $6.9 billion consortium acquisition of BMC Software, the closing of Insight Venture Partners VIII (a new $2.57 billion private equity fund) and the acquisition of Kaseya Software Ltd. https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/12/wil.title: Willkie Represents Unitrends in its Acquisition of PHD Virtual Technologies
https://www.willkie.com/news/2013/12/wil.text: Two portfolio companies of Insight Venture Partners unite to create small and mid-market data protection platform. Unitrends, the leading provider of all-in-one backup, archiving, instant recovery and disaster recovery solutions, announced it has signed an agreement to acquire PHD Virtual Technologies, an innovator of virtual backup and disaster recovery assurance solutions. The acquisition will enable Unitrends to leverage PHD Virtual's proven technology platform and data protection products, designed for small and medium-size businesses. Both companies have primary investments from Insight Venture Partners, a leading global private equity and venture capital firm. Since its founding in 1995, Insight has raised more than $7.6 billion and invested in more than 190 growth-stage software, eCommerce, internet, and data-services companies. Willkie recently handled Insight’s acquisition of Unitrends. https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/03/fir.title: Firm Advises Insight Venture Partners as Lead Investor in Oil and Gas Data Intelligence Provider
https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/03/fir.text: Insight Venture partners leads $165 million investment in Drilling Info, Inc., acquiring majority ownership of the Austin, TX-based company. On March 5, it was announced that Willkie client Insight Venture Partners is leading a $165 million equity investment in Drilling Info, Inc., the Austin-based data intelligence provider to the oil and gas industries. With part of the proceeds being used to buy out existing shareholders, Insight will acquire a majority ownership position in the company. The investment is expected to drive expansion and new product development for Drilling Info. With more than 20,000 users and 2,700 accounts globally, Drilling Info members produce more than 90 percent of domestic oil and gas in the United States. The company has offices throughout the U.S. oil patch in addition to the UK, Southeast Asia and South America. New York-based Insight Venture Partners is a leading private equity and venture capital firm focused on the global software, Internet and data-services industries. Willkie has advised Insight in a host of transactions including most recently representing it as selling shareholder in Google’s acquisition of Berlin-based daily bargains website DailyDeal GmbH and assisting it in the formation of new funds totaling $2 billion. The current deal was handled by partners Gordon Caplan, Morgan Elwyn, Christopher Peters and Michael Katz, and associates Tyler Barnett, Jennifer Long and Sarah Woodberry.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/03/wil.title: Willkie Advises Insight Venture Partners in $2 Billion Buyout of Quest Software
https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/03/wil.text: Database applications provider Quest Software agrees to be taken private by affiliates of Insight. On March 9, it was announced that Quest Software, Inc. has entered into definitive agreements with affiliates of Willkie client Insight Venture Partners, under which the database applications provider will be taken private in a deal valued at approximately $2 billion. The transaction, which has been widely reported in the press, calls for stockholders not affiliated with the buyout group to receive $23.00 per share in cash. Established in 1987, Quest provides IT management solutions for more than 100,000 global customers, ranging from database management, data protection, identity and access management, monitoring, user workspace management to Windows management. New York-based Insight Venture Partners is a leading private equity and venture capital firm focused on the global software, Internet and data-services industries. On March 5, it was announced that Willkie advised Insight on its deal to acquire oil and gas data intelligence provider Drilling Info Inc. Willkie has advised Insight in a host of transactions including recent high-profile deals such as the sale of TicketMonster, an Insight portfolio company in S.Korea to Living Social; the sale of DailyDeal GmbH, an Insight portfolio company in Germany, to Google; and in the formation of new funds totaling $2 billion.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/06/fir.title: Firm Advises Insight Venture Partners in Latest Investment
https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/06/fir.text: Insight leads consortium investment in B2B-Center, Russia’s leading online procurement platform. On June 4, it was announced that a consortium of investors led by Willkie client Insight Venture Partners and Da Vinci Capital, and including ALPHA Associates and Runa Capital, has acquired a significant minority stake in B2B-Center, Russia's leading online procurement platform for businesses to sell or acquire goods and services. The investment is intended to support B2B-Center’s ongoing growth and expansion into new vertical markets and new product types. B2B-Center, the largest operator of an online procurement marketplace in Russia, enables its business clients to list and sell, or find and procure, products and services, and thus extend sales channels for suppliers while improving efficiency in supply chain procurement. Earlier this year, this firm advised Insight in the $2 billion buyout of Quest Software, and in its acquisition of a controlling interest in oil and gas data intelligence provider Drilling Info Inc., among other transactions. In 2011, Willkie represented Insight in several high-profile deals, including the sale of TicketMonster, an Insight portfolio company in South Korea, to Living Social; the sale of DailyDeal GmbH, an Insight portfolio company in Germany, to Google; and in the formation of new funds totaling $2 billion. The current deal was handed by partners Gordon Caplan, Morgan Elwyn. William Dye and Christopher Peters and associate Andrew Lloyd.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/06/wil.title: Willkie Advises Brazil’s Folhamatic Group in Acquisition Agreement by UK-Based Sage Group
https://www.willkie.com/news/2012/06/wil.text: Sage Group plc enters into an agreement to acquire a controlling interest in Folhamatic Group, a leading Brazil-based tax and accounting software company, for expected consideration of £125 million ($196 million). On June 20, UK-based Sage Group plc announced that it had entered into an agreement to acquire a controlling interest in Willkie client Folhamatic Group, a leading provider of accounting, tax and payroll, and regulatory content software in Brazil, for expected consideration of about £125 million ($196 million). The total consideration for 75% of the equity equates to an enterprise value for 100% of the business, including estimated net debt at closing of £191 million. In June 2011, Willkie represented Insight Venture Partners in connection with its acquisition of a majority interest in Folhamatic, and in November 2011 assisted Folhamatic in its acquisition of Brazilian tax and regulatory publisher IOB Informações Objetivas Publicações Jurídicas. The current deal was handled by partners Gordon Caplan and Rosalind Fahey Kruse; Latin American counsel Maria-Leticia Ossa Daza; and associates Matthew Guercio and Ruchi Patel.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2006/08/wil.title: Willkie Advises Insight Venture Partners in Connection with Leveraged Acquisition of eCommerce Industries
https://www.willkie.com/news/2006/08/wil.text: On August 8, Willkie client Insight Venture Partners, a leading private equity firm in the area of software and technology investments, announced the acquisition of, and investment in, eCommerce Industries, Inc. (ECI2). A leading developer of industry-specific business systems, ECI2 plans to use the funds to support growth into new vertical markets through new product development and the acquisition of enterprise resource planning (ERP) companies with significant domain expertise. In conjunction with the closing of the investment, Insight supported ECI2's acquisition of Britannia Inc., a leading automation provider for the office products industry. https://www.willkie.com/news/2004/06/fir.title: Firm Represents Insight Venture Capital Partners as Lead Investor in eEye Digital Security
https://www.willkie.com/news/2004/06/fir.text: eEye Digital Security raises funds in a fourth round led by Menlo Park, Calif-based Bessemer Venture Partners to continue development and expand the marketing of products focused on preventive security. On June 3, it was announced that network protection software maker eEye Digital Security raised $15 million in a fourth round led by Menlo Park, Calif-based Bessemer Venture Partners to continue development and expand the marketing of products focused on preventive security. Willkie client and third-round lead investor Insight Venture Partners of New York also contributed to this round, which brings total investment in eEye to $30 million since it was formed in 2000. The company raised its first institutional round only after being approached by Insight, which specializes in investing in profitable companies with revenues of more than $4 million. The June 4 Daily Deal notes that partner Gordon Caplan represented Insight.

https://www.willkie.com/news/2004/01/que.title: Quest Software Inc. Acquires Willkie Client Aelita Software
https://www.willkie.com/news/2004/01/que.text: Quest Software Inc. acquires Willkie client Aelita Software, a privately held provider of enterprise management software, for $115 million. On January 28, it was announced that Quest Software Inc. would acquire Willkie client Aelita Software, a privately held provider of enterprise management software, for $115 million. The transaction favors Insight Venture Partners, which invested $10 million for an approximate one-third stake in Aelita in 2002. Aelita, based in Columbus Ohio, develops tools designed to assist large corporations install and manage their Microsoft-based networks. The January 29 Daily Deal reports that Willkie partners Gordon Caplan and Andrew Needham, and special counsel Claudia Cantarella handled the deal, which is expected to close by the end of the first quarter.
